description.content: Opens workspace text and code files in Monaco inside the right sidebar, editable and savable in place with a version guard against concurrent disk changes, and lets other plugins register languages, highlight rules, themes, commands and actions.
在右侧边栏用 Monaco 打开工作区里的文本与代码文件，可直接编辑并保存，保存带版本守卫以防覆盖磁盘上的并发修改；同时向其他插件开放语言、高亮规则、主题、命令与动作的注册接口。
